sources.claim: SentinelLABS reports that a Play ESXi variant contains the same file-searching functionality as baseline Babuk and implements the same encryption approach.

curator_note: Variant-scoped edge only. This does not assert that all Play ransomware descends from Babuk.
confidence_reason: SentinelLABS provides direct reverse-engineering evidence for the ESXi locker variant, but the relationship is intentionally scoped to that variant.
